newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AHEAD OF NEW YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AHEAD OF NEW YEAR.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed softer against most major currencies on New Year's eve on the back of slight import pressure, foreign exchange dealers said.

"There was a bit of a seesaw on the market today. The dollar fell to 10.8400/8600 at one point prompting the (central) Reserve Bank to come in to support the unit at the 10.8400 level. I think there was a big buyer in the market today," a dealer said.
He said the local currency finally settled at 10.8350/8550 against the key U.S. unit, half a cent down from where it closed the previous day.
It also fell to 18.4000/4200 against sterling from 18.2860/3260, largely tracking a weaker U.S. dollar against the British unit overseas and eased to 6.9700/9900 from 6.9540/9690 against the mark.
The Zimbabwe dollar however finished the day marginally firmer at 2.3100/3300 versus the rand compared to late Monday's 2.3130/3200.
